slug: 2024-11-19 HISP WCA develops DHIS2 EMIS for education data analysis and visualization in Togo

facts.fact: HISP WCA, with GPE KIX and Norad, built a DHIS2-based education management information system (SIGE) for Togo's education ministry, implemented in 2021 in interoperability with StatEduc and described as currently under review by the ministry.
Data from the country's 16,000 schools are entered into StatEduc, which the ministry uses for statistical analysis, with DHIS2 processing and providing information products from it since 2021.

TGO.note: The document describes only an education system; it states nothing on health reporting.
